description: This file contains unit tests for the JobTitleService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods related to job title retrieval, deletion, and conversion to arrays within the admin service context.

classes.name: JobTitleServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the JobTitleService functionalities in the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a JobTitleService instance and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job title list by mocking the DAO method and verifying the service returns the expected list.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests deletion of job titles by IDs, mocking DAO behavior, and asserting returned delete count.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific job title by ID, ensuring the service returns the correct entity.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of job title list to associative array suitable for front-end, including normalization.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval and array conversion of job titles applicable to an employee.
